source_inspection.authority: Existing authenticate mount and operational-pharmacy guard precede dedicated query validation; only guard-resolved pharmacyId is forwarded. Required canonical scope and closed plain/data query validation precede aggregate. No admin/query/body fallback.
source_inspection.query: One scoped first match with array/scalar-owner predicates, position-preserving narrow batch map, unwind and exact scalar status re-match; common facet counts occurrences before page/lookup; page sort by original item/position; name-only bounded lookup preserves missing reference rows.
source_inspection.projection: One newly constructed row with only contracted scalar fields; actual ObjectId conversion only for three ID fields; stored text and quantities retain bounded exact values or null, never inferred zero/truncated IDs. Required ID/position/count/result shape errors use fixed503.
source_inspection.effects: No new clock/date logic, database writer, quality/stock/release/clinical command, logger, provider, background task or index operation. New service only delegates.
source_inspection.pagination: Positive totals survive beyond-end empty data; zero total only when count is zero. Exactly bounded response rows and count shape are checked.

response_bound.fixed_fields: Three24-hex ID fields, exact13-key row, nonnegative safe-number counters/position, boolean/null and closed status. Fixed signed scope/expiryEvaluation/pagination envelope.
response_bound.runtime_claim: NONE: Python reference-data arithmetic only; emitted JSON/Joi/Mongoose/pipeline behavior NOT_RUN.
